usedFor: HDFC Smart GATEWAY takes payments, and “Create Payment Session” generates a hosted payment page link.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting” in Google Meet, then “Create Payment Session” in HDFC Smart GATEWAY
bestTemplate.why: The action creates a payment session and returns a hosted payment page link you can pass on.

watchOut: A payment link that reaches a customer waits in Needs you until you approve it.
